reason: Real Product Experience Task 9 Windows run 31454992682 / job 93666828025 at exact Product Head 249b803257441a553627b8ff5a0913529eba4f67 proved the Element 0001 textual repair, Element-local pnpm authority, exact frozen install and postinstall chain, then entered Nx build and failed because Nx 23.1.0 could not parse the pinned Element pnpm 11 multi-document lockfile after Windows CRLF materialization. Pinned Element a2a996ae50d802878bf48e4bbf3730004bdcc55c intentionally carries a multi-document pnpm-lock.yaml: pnpm 11.5.2 accepts it, but Nx 23.1.0 extractMainLockfileDocument hard-codes LF-only document separators. Nx upstream fixed the exact Windows CRLF defect in commit b8dca5e4f9315b989d0c2f7a336868ecd91a36fa / PR #36419 and released the fix in stable Nx 23.1.1 on 2026-07-30. Element upstream independently adopted Nx 23.1.1 in commit 27f0347668494711ae25466b3d81434a65011df6 / PR #34530. The root repair therefore backports the official stable Nx 23.1.1 dependency and its minimal Nx-only lock closure onto the frozen Element source through one dedicated ordinary textual upstream patch. The Element lock structure, document markers, line-ending behavior, Element pin, pnpm 11.5.2, Product dependency overlay 0011, Yance runtime and final-validation workflow remain unchanged.

evidence.failureBoundary: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and Element postinstall completed successfully; pnpm exec nx build yance-element-module then failed in Nx pnpm-normalizer with expected a single document in the stream, but found more; lint:types was not entered

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: A dedicated upstream patch must update pinned Element from exact Nx 23.1.0 to stable Nx 23.1.1 and must bind its package.json hunk to old blob 1458c14e3e59f6fa7c948b5ffb7de4404c1cb5f5 and its pnpm-lock.yaml hunk to old blob 7e1974c8c927b6e1f1672051833890932264ef33.
The patch must preserve the existing two-document pnpm lock structure and must not delete or rewrite YAML document markers to avoid the Nx defect.

The pnpm-lock.yaml portion must be limited to the Nx 23.1.0 to 23.1.1 dependency closure and exact related native Nx package records; unrelated matrix-js-sdk, React, axios, brace-expansion or other dependency drift from newer Element branches is forbidden.

tools/matrix/bootstrap.js must replay the dedicated Nx patch through the existing fail-closed applyPatch mechanism after the package-manager authority patch and before Product module copy; Product 0011 remains a separate later overlay and must not be folded into this work package.

No Corepack strict disable, git autocrlf manipulation, line-ending rewrite, Nx plugin disable, lockfile parser bypass, Yance lock regeneration, Element pin change, pnpm version change or final-validation workflow change is permitted.

A subsequent real Windows Task 9 must prove frozen install and postinstall remain GREEN, then prove Nx build crosses the prior CRLF multi-document parser failure before any conclusion is drawn about lint:types.
